newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 3.

text.p: All major ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT to large vessels, but Coatzacoalcos in Veracruz state was shut to minor shipping, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said in a daily update.
Mexico's three Gulf crude export ports reopened after Monday's closure, port officials said.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Light rains along the coast of southern Baja California, Sonora, Sinaloa, Nayarit and Jalisco states. Winds from the north and northeast of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour).
Cold front bringing light rains, winds from the northeast at 10 to 20 knots (19 to 37 kilometers/11 to 22 miles per hour).

New light cold front appearing in past 12 hours hitting northeast gulf, with north, northeast winds of between 15 to 20 knots and waves between four and seven feet high. Expected to reach the coast of Tamaulipas state later today.
Tropical air carrying light rains over the coast of Quintana Roo state. Winds from the northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
